root_cause: Prepared inputs can retain older normalized gold_plans while schema_link_labels still hold the current SQL-derived selected-expression order. Planner scoring and planner-SFT data construction previously preferred gold_plan/gold_plans when both were present, so stale generated prepared artifacts could silently score or train against old projection order.
code_changes: eval.run_eval.expand_prepared_record now prefers schema_link_labels over gold_plans when both answer-key sources are present.
eval.planner_eval.evaluate_planner_records now prefers schema_link_labels over gold_plan for expanded planner scoring rows.
eval.planner_eval.annotate_prepared_records_with_plans now writes gold_plans from schema_link_labels when available, avoiding stale normalized gold_plans in predicted-planner prepared artifacts.
data.planner_sft now receives current schema_link_labels through load_prepared_records, so planner-SFT targets use the current SQL-derived label source.

readiness_impact.primary_blocker: selected-expression identity remains below policy after correcting answer-key source precedence
readiness_impact.next_step: Regenerate planner-SFT data from the corrected answer-key source and improve selected-expression identity before another same-row SQL pair.

interpretation: The aggregate selected-expression order metric did not change on the 24-turn user-only slice because one stale-label false negative and one stale-label false positive canceled out.
The fix still matters because future planner scoring, predicted-prepared artifacts, and planner-SFT targets now use the current SQL-derived schema labels instead of stale normalized gold_plans.
Checkpoint 5 remains in progress; this is a label-source integrity fix, not a planner promotion.
